title: Bisbenzylisoquinoline alkaloid fangchinoline derivative HY-2 inhibits breast cancer cells by suppressing BLM DNA helicase.
authors: Zhang, Wangming; Yu, Xiaojing; Bao, Linchun; He, Tianhui; Pan, Weidong; Li, Pinhao; Liu, Jinhe; Liu, Xiaohua; Yang, Liuqi; Liu, Jielin
one_liner_zh: 该文研究小分子HY-2抑制BLM DNA解旋酶的抗癌机制，涉及蛋白-DNA结合抑制和分子动力学模拟，但对象为解旋酶而非转录因子，方法以实验为主、模拟为辅，属广义蛋白-DNA互作且方法可借鉴。
abstract: The high expression of BLM (Bloom syndrome) DNA helicase in tumors involves its strong association with cell expansion. Bisbenzylisoquinoline alkaloids own an antitumor property and have developed as candidates for anticancer drugs. This paper aimed to study the antitumor effect of fangchinoline derivative HY-2 by targeting BLM(642-1290) DNA helicase, and then explore its inhibitory mechanism on proliferation of MDA-MB-435 breast cancer cells. We confirmed that the mRNA and protein levels of BLM DNA helicase in breast cancer were higher than those in normal tissues. HY-2 could inhibit the DNA binding, ATPase and DNA unwinding of BLM(642-1290) DNA helicase with enzymatic assay. HY-2 could also inhibit the DNA unwinding of DNA helicase in cells. In addition, HY-2 showed an inhibiting the MDA-MB-435, MDA-MB-231, MDA-MB-436 breast cancer cells expansion. The mRNA and protein levels of BLM DNA helicase in MDA-MB-435 cells increased after HY-2 treatment, which might contribute to HY-2 inhibiting the DNA binding, ATPase and DNA unwinding of BLM DNA helicase. The mechanism of HY-2 inhibition on BLM DNA helicase was further confirmed with the effect of HY-2 on the ultraviolet spectrogram of BLM(642-1290) DNA helicase and Molecular dynamics simulation of the interacting between HY-2 and BLM(640-1291) DNA helicase. Our study provided some valuable clues for the exploration of HY-2 in the living body and developing it as an anticancer drug.
abstract_zh: BLM（Bloom综合征）DNA解旋酶在肿瘤中的高表达与其与细胞扩增的强烈关联有关。双苄基异喹啉生物碱具有抗肿瘤特性，并已发展为抗癌药物的候选物。本文旨在研究靶向BLM(642-1290) DNA解旋酶的防己诺林碱衍生物HY-2的抗肿瘤效果，并进一步探讨其对MDA-MB-435乳腺癌细胞增殖的抑制机制。我们确认了乳腺癌中BLM DNA解旋酶的mRNA和蛋白水平高于正常组织。酶学实验表明，HY-2能抑制BLM(642-1290) DNA解旋酶的DNA结合、ATPase活性和DNA解旋功能。HY-2还能抑制细胞内DNA解旋酶的DNA解旋活性。此外，HY-2显示出对MDA-MB-435、MDA-MB-231、MDA-MB-436乳腺癌细胞扩增的抑制作用。HY-2处理后，MDA-MB-435细胞中BLM DNA解旋酶的mRNA和蛋白水平升高，这可能有助于HY-2抑制BLM DNA解旋酶的DNA结合、ATPase活性和DNA解旋功能。通过HY-2对BLM(642-1290) DNA解旋酶紫外光谱的影响以及HY-2与BLM(640-1291) DNA解旋酶相互作用的分子动力学模拟，进一步证实了HY-2对BLM DNA解旋酶的抑制机制。我们的研究为HY-2在体内的探索及其作为抗癌药物的开发提供了一些有价值的线索。
